description: R is a language for exploring numbers and data. It is useful for tables, summaries and charts. These 12 starter lessons use small examples and simple words. Read the result, make one small change, and try the practice question. Install R. Save an example as lesson.R and run Rscript lesson.R, or paste it into the R console.
versionNote: Examples use base R 4.2 or later; no extra packages are needed.
learningObjectives: Do maths on a vector with R
Make a data table with R
